date_scope_check.qualification_retained: R5-ME-006-D1: The passenger episode occurred within April 4, not over a whole day. QNA relays the Iraqi Border Ports Authority through INA; Reuters also cites security sources. The Wall Street Journal separately reports that Khuzestan official Lofteh Derokvandi told IRNA that pilgrim and trader crossings had resumed and commercial activity was continuing. This is evidence of commercial operation by April 4 evening, but does not identify the first truck, precise interruption hours or identical conditions in both directions. The underlying IRNA report has not been recovered independently.
